steps.text: Gummy has many memories.
Good ones, bad ones.
Happy ones, sad ones.
And ones she can't forget, no matter what.

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: They're in here!

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: Hurry up, don't let them get away... They have food!

steps.name: Anna
steps.text: Lada, be careful!

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: Grrr, what a bunch of pests! Anna, Lada, stay behind me!

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: Heh, you lot've got some nerve. C'mere, and we'll see who has the guts!

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Dammit, it still hurts... Why are they here again? My arm hasn't fully healed yet.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Hey, Sonya, why don't we have a little contest to see who can take down more gopniks?

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: Cut the bullshit... Watch out!

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Come now, this is not the time to lose focus.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Our two generals have a job to do.

steps.name: Anna
steps.text: Phew... That was a close one.

steps.name: Anna
steps.text: Sonya, Rosalind, watch your back.

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: If you have the stones to sneak up on me, I guess you're ready to meet your maker!

steps.name: Female Student
steps.text: D-Don't panic, don't let them intimidate you. We have the numbers...

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: That's right, there's only a few of 'em! Don't give them the chance to call for help. If we all charge together, we'll be fine!

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: (Do you have a plan? It's true, they have us outnumbered.)

steps.name: Anna
steps.text: (All we can do is think up a way to break out.)

steps.name: Female Student
steps.text: I'm sorry, but... we don't have a choice. We need that food...

steps.name: Female Student
steps.text: I don't want to starve... I don't want to starve to death in a place like this!

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: Don't give 'em a chance to escape! Block the door!

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: Get 'em!

a.text: It's dangerous up ahead. Sonya, Rosalind...
Anna, you don't need to stand in front of me.
Natalya, don't get hurt trying to protect me.
It's dangerous... It's dangerous... It's dangerous...!
I don't want to see my friends get hurt again.
I don't want to have to hide behind my friends anymore.
I... I want to be the one who protects everyone else.
If once isn't good enough, then I'll try twice. If twice isn't good enough, then I'll try three times.
I can do anything to protect my friends.
I will use all of my strength––

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... These bastards, there's no end to 'em!

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Don't tell me you're throwing in the towel already?

steps.name: Rosalind
steps.text: Bah. Ugh, I think I lost a tooth.

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Natalya
steps.text: Wait, something isn't right about their numbers!

steps.name: Anna
steps.text: Sonya, watch out!!

steps.name: Sonya
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: Hand the food over!!

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: Graaaaahhh!!

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: *cough*... Guh...

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: (*Falls to the ground, twitching*)

steps.name: Anna
steps.text: ...Lada?

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Don't hurt Sonya.

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: I won't let you...

steps.name: Female Student
steps.text: Eek!

steps.name: Female Student
steps.text: She's crazy!

steps.name: Male Student
steps.text: She broke Andrey's neck! Be careful, everyone!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: I... I will protect everyone!

steps.name: Lada
steps.text: Don't hurt my friends!!
Gummy has many memories.
Good ones, bad ones.
Happy ones, sad ones.
And ones she doesn't ever want to remember, no matter what.
Gummy has hurt other people.
Was it to protect her friends, or to not get hurt herself?
Gummy does not know.
But Gummy... Gummy doesn't want to hurt other people anymore.
Gummy?
How did you fall asleep over here?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Wake up, Gummy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ugh... Huh...?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Wake up, Gummy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're paler than a ghost. Are your wounds still bothering you?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I think I had a nightmare.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It doesn't hurt anymore, so don't worry. I'll be fine.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: That's good.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Huh? Istina?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Why'd you stop talking? Are you about to leave? I can leave too. What about Zima and Leto?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No, it's not time to leave yet. You rest some more.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The others went ahead to scout out the way. They should be back soon.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Then, I'm gonna go help too!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Not so fast.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: One moment, Gummy. Don't start running around just yet.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Your wound's not as light as you think it is. Hold still so I can apply another dose of medicine.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It really isn't that serious though.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Honest! I swear!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It just... kind of stings a little bit, that's all...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Be a good girl, don't move.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Fine, if you say so!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You've taken a lot of hits.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The scar from the previous injury seems to have gotten a bit lighter. I'm not sure if the wound this time is going to leave a mark.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I hope it doesn't.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The nice ladies from the Medical Department give me a super easy-to-use ointment. I rub it on every day, and the scars go right away!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sure enough. All the scars you've gotten this last year have been treated pretty well.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy, when those bounty hunters attacked us earlier, you could've avoided getting injured, right?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Why didn't you keep chasing after them?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: When you were about to knock them out, you hesitated and held back... That's dangerous, Gummy.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But, I...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I didn't have a choice.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Instructor Dur-nar asked me about your habit before.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The Instructor...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're afraid, aren't you?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: ...Mhm.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm very afraid.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: The third time, I couldn't control myself...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I keep thinking back to that time at the school. I get nightmares about it. Even my night light doesn't help.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I... I know. You toss and turn and have trouble sleeping.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Both Zima and I know, but this is something you have to overcome by yourself, so we try not to say too much.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: But, Gummy, we're all worried about you.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm trying my hardest.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Yes, I know. You are trying.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're the strongest one out of all of us.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You don't need a night light to fall asleep anymore, right?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Though you still sometimes come running to me and Zima.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll work hard to grow up and get over my bad habits.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I also asked Amiya and Dr. Kal'tsit. Dr. Kal'tsit said that Papa and Mama have very dangerous jobs, and it'll be really hard to see them.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Do you want to go look for them?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I do. But I can't yet.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I don't want Papa and Mama to see me like this. I don't want them to think that I'm a bad girl.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: So I can't yet.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're not a bad girl, Gummy. You're keeping us safe.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But, but––

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm not good enough yet...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I can't control myself, and I hurt other people.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Istina, what should I do?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You'll find a way.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You might not be able to change things right away, but that's okay too. We'll here with you.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: We'll always be with you, so don't be afraid.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Istina...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Yeah! As long as you're with me, I have nothing to be afraid of!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Alright, brave little bear, don't let yourself get hurt anymore!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Owwie, stop poking! Stop poking me, it hurts!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So now you know it hurts?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Alright, all done applying the medicine. Zima and the others should be back soon.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Let's go check on them.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Have a nice rest?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm all better now, Zima!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I treated her wounds, so they won't get in the way.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: How are things on your end?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Getting some bad vibes from that village up ahead. It's too quiet.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Might be another bounty hunter trap for all we know, so keep your guard up.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Our mission was originally to search for the missing children. My, what an unexpected turn of events.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: How did we get all these bounty hunters after us?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Huh? They were the ones who started it!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Those bastards had two kids tied up! Weren't we looking for missing children?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Well, whatever. We already got ourselves involved, so we can't just turn a blind eye now.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: They might've gotten away last time, but they won't get that lucky again.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Just don't get too carried away. They aren't exactly easy to deal with.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Plus, those children are their hostages. We can't get them too worked up.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If the bad guys show up again, I'll protect everyone!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm gonna send them packing!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: But, what if they don't show up?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Um... Then, I'll flush them out?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Pain in my ass.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I have an idea.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hello—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Excuse me, is anyone home?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hello—

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Guess not...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Well, looks like we won't learn anything new here.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Guess we should get going then.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: So we're to return empty-handed? They will have to send some other operators out to try again.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Oh... But that means they'll be sending more experienced operators, right?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah, that's right!

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: I heard that, err, whatsherface... Well, whatever, there's a super strong bounty hunter who can tear down entire buildings with her bare hands!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Rosalind, you're a terrible actor...)

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: (Hey, I was never good at this stuff!!)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Let's get going!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm sure the senior operators will be able to catch the bad guys!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (I hear something! Someone's coming!)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy, be careful!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hold it right there!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Don't poke your noses where they don't belong, little bears.

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Or you'll regret it.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Naw, we don't regret shit! Come try me on for size!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Save it.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, lemme ask you a question. These all the guys you have with you?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What'd you do with the villagers? And those two kids you abducted?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (They're not talking.)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I suppose we'll have to beat it out of them.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yo, that's what I like to hear!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: It's certainly easy enough to talk big, but you do know this is different from a training simulation, right?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: We've got this!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll protect everyone!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ow!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Heavy! But I can still hold...!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hyaaah!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Hah!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (*Slows down*)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Gah, out of my way!

steps.name: Quiet Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Dammit, we were so close...

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: We almost had that bastard!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Stay focused!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Ngh!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Istina! Stand behind me!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You won't get through me!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Careful, Gummy!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I'll slow them down...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now's your chance, Zima!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: On it!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Piece o' cake.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: My, such tough words from such a winded girl.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Zima!!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You're hurt! W-Was that because you took a hit for me just now?!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's all my fault...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Stop your blubbering already, it's annoying.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Yeah, she obviously got way too careless! It had nothing to do with you, Gummy!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But still!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We've got more pressing issues on our hands right now.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Hey, you! What's the play? You're the only one left.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Spit it out. What happened to the village? And what'd you do with the kids?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: If you're not gonna talk...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If you're not gonna talk, then, we're gonna pull out all your hair and teeth!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: (Probably don't have to go that far.)

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Heh. You're just a bunch of runts.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Watch your damn mouth!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: So you can deliver a beating or two. So what?

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You wanna find those kids?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Sure do!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Out with it already!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Haha... dumb runt.

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Too bad for you, I'm the only one who knows where those kids are.

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Something happens to me and you'll never find them.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You'll talk, if you know what's good for you.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: In a situation like this, I would expect you to try negotiating with us.

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Let us go.

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Then we'll take those kids back to the village. As for the other stuff, you mind your own business.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: That's all you got?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Sucks for you, but–– no deal.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Why would we negotiate with a loser like you?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Yeah, yeah!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (He went quiet.)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: (Is he gonna do that thing where you bite your tongue until you die?)

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (This is tricky, but we don't necessarily have to force it out of him...)

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Just smack him around a couple more times and we'll be good!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Ah, you're not supposed to raise your voice like that, Zima!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: How dare you treat me like this...

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: ––You damned runts!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Zima!!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What?! Woah!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You son of a bitch!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: A bitch, huh?

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Of course I'm gonna play every card in my hand!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Now die!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Sonya!

a.text: It's dangerous... It's dangerous... It's dangerous...!
Gummy will protect everyone, no matter what.
It's dangerous... It's dangerous... It's dangerous...!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Damn you, little—!

steps.name: Sullen Bounty Hunter
steps.text: *cough*... Guh...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I won't let you...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I won't let you hurt Sonya!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: One more hit...!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Wait, Gummy! I'm fine! Calm down!

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: We still need to find out where the kids are!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I, I––

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Gummy... Are you okay?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Holy shit... Is he dead?

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: No, he's still alive.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: My dear Rosalind, would you mind helping me carry this gentleman over there? I'm going to stop the bleeding, then help him 'wake up.'

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Sure thing... But why are you calling me that? It's freakin' me out.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Fine, fine. Come now.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Zima, your wound... There's blood! I, I'll help you bandage it!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'm sorry, Zima, Istina. I... messed up again...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Cut the crap.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: What'd you mess up? You saved me. I didn't even have a chance to thank you.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: No buts.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy, you were scared, but you still protected us.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Exactly.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Besides... I know exactly how strong you are. If you really bashed his head in with all your strength, his brains would be splattered all over the ground.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: But he––

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: He's fine. Don't worry.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: Actually, can't you smack him again to wake him up?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: It's okay...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I, I kept things under control...

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You did.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: During that last swing, you managed to hold back your power. I saw it, clear as day.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Come here.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You too, Zima.

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: You don't need us?

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: What are you playing at?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Settle down! Stop crowding around me!
Amidst the chaos, the children of the Ursus Student Self-government Group form an intimate gathering.

Istina takes Gummy's left hand, while Zima takes her right hand. The little bears hold hands, their foreheads touching. Nobody backs away even when their cheeks get itchy brushing against their friends' hair.
Gummy presses her head against her friends', their foreheads gently touching just as they always do when they play together.
And her friends press back against her intimately.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy, do you remember what I said before?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You're doing great.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Don't be afraid. We'll always be with you.

steps.name: Leto
steps.text: That's right, you heard her! You did a great job, Gummy! That last block was great!

steps.name: Rosa
steps.text: Hehe, you're almost stronger than a certain someone who can't control her temper.

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: Huuuuh? You talkin' about me?!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Pfft...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Zima, don't start jumping around! Your wounds!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Have I...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Have I really done it? Did I really manage to control my strength?

steps.name: Zima
steps.text: You did. You held back.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I do think we'll be able to wake that fellow up pretty soon. Then we can ask where the children are.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Trust me. I have ways of making him talk.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Gummy, you not only protected us, but also those children.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I... kept things under control...

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I did it!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I'll have to bring this along, and that... Oh, and some bread too!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Phew... I've finally finished packing my bag.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Papa, Mama, Lada is going to go find you two soon!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Even though Dr. Kal'tsit said it'll be hard, I still want to give it a try!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: By the way, I don't have to hesitate when hitting people anymore... Because I know I'll be able to control my strength at the end!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: I won't be a burden on my friends... and I won't be a burden on Papa and Mama.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Thanks to them, even though I still have nightmares, I'm not so scared anymore.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Papa, Mama, I'm having a great time here.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Oh, I have to go meet up with my friends now. This will be my first time going out on my own, but I'll definitely come back. I know they'll be waiting for me.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Alright, I'll end the recording right there.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: ––Let's gooo!
